posts.name: Moli by Lexmount
posts.tagline: The fastest headless browser for agents and harnesses
posts.description: Moli by Lexmount is our browser engine built from scratch for AI agents. It starts faster and uses less memory than Chrome. Use Moli through Lexmount Browser, our cloud browser platform. Run multiple isolated browser sessions with proxy support while we handle the infrastructure. Let your agents browse, fill out forms, and extract data. Try it in our Playground or connect through our SDK.

posts.name: AgentGrid.io
posts.tagline: Shared workspace for humans and agents
posts.description: Built for Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Claude, GPT, OpenClaw, Cursor, Codex, all agents are welcome. Work on the same live artifacts. Docs, reports, slides, apps, and designs, with shared context, controlled access, and full version history.

posts.name: Badgey
posts.tagline: Your iPhone becomes a name badge that faces the room
posts.description: Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. On a lanyard, it turns to face the people you meet and swings as you move. In a chest pocket, it shrinks so your name shows above the edge. Several badges, a QR code for your link, five designs.

posts.name: Openstatus Incident Management
posts.tagline: Incident management for small teams
posts.description: Open source incident management next to your monitors and status page. Declare from Slack, get a channel per incident, keep a timeline and draft the postmortem.

posts.name: git-flow-next
posts.tagline: Your favorite Git workflow. Reimagined.
posts.description: A flexible, modern approach to the popular git-flow branching model. Download the CLI tool to get started with a better Git workflow: brew install git-flow-next

posts.name: Llama Windows
posts.tagline: One local AI server for all your Windows apps
posts.description: Llama Windows brings llama.cpp to the Windows 11 system tray. Download open models from Hugging Face in one click, chat via Alt+Space, and let coding agents, editors and scripts share a local OpenAI-compatible API and model cache. Free and open source.

posts.name: MRRaudit
posts.tagline: Understand why your MRR differs and get a number you trust
posts.description: MRRaudit explains why your MRR numbers differ so you can get to a figure you trust. Compare Stripe and ChartMogul customer by customer, trace discrepancies to invoices and subscription events, and choose how billing events affect MRR. Built by the ChartMogul team, who've obsessed over SaaS metrics since 2014 and helped thousands of SaaS businesses investigate these differences by hand through calls and support tickets. Read-only access. No ChartMogul account required.

posts.name: Papermark Data Rooms
posts.tagline: Secure data rooms your AI agents can run. Live in < 60 sec.
posts.description: Data Rooms 2.0: launch a secure data room in under 60 seconds. Encrypted, fully certified, with file permissions, built-in Q&A, a full audit log and analytics. White-label it on your domain, or let agents run it via API, CLI and MCP.

posts.name: pawl
posts.tagline: a tiny mac focus timer you start by pulling a paw
posts.description: start a focus timer by pulling a cat paw, it lives in your mac menu bar or you can pin it like a mini timer! it has adjustable focus and break sessions, eight cat paws, themes, and a quiet heads-up before your timer ends. made for macos 14+. $9.99 once, with no subscription.

posts.name: Clips by Plastic
posts.tagline: Lyric video ads for every part of your song, on the beat
posts.description: Drop in a finished song and your own footage or photos. Clips finds the tempo and every part (verses, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge) and makes a vertical lyric video for each one, cut on the beat, with the words synced. Pick a layout and one of 54 effects, then export every part on every backdrop at once, named and ready for Ads Manager. Run them all for a week and put your budget behind the part that wins. Works offline. Free to try, then $99 once.

posts.name: Yourcast 2.0
posts.tagline: AI summaries with tap-to-jump timestamps, right in Telegram
posts.description: Yourcast is a Telegram bot for podcasts: search a show, tap to subscribe, and new episodes arrive as audio right in your chat. 2.0 adds AI summaries with timestamps you can tap to jump in the audio, questions about any episode, feeds that repair themselves, files up to 2 GB, OPML import and payments in Telegram Stars. Free: 10 episodes a week on demand. Open source (GPL v3). In English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Hebrew.

posts.name: How It Spread
posts.tagline: See how anything went viral, from the first post
posts.description: A library of 1,600+ viral films, products, memes and campaigns.

posts.name: Specsight
posts.tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
posts.description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

posts.name: Sunlight Diary
posts.tagline: AI cheerleader based on daily sunlight target
posts.description: Meet Sunlight Diary, a personal cheerleader based on daily sunlight target. Our AI agent helps you choose a daily sunlight goal, get a suggested outdoor routine, record your time outside, and check in with how you feel. Louie is your companion along the way. Try it in your phone's browser — no wearable needed.

posts.name: Save My Prompts
posts.tagline: Save the prompts that work. Reuse them everywhere.
posts.description: Save My Prompts helps you save, organize, improve, and reuse your best AI prompts across your workflow. Create reusable templates with customizable variables, find prompts instantly, organize projects with boards, and access your library through browser extensions and supported AI integrations. Stop rewriting prompts from scratch and spend more time getting useful results from AI.

posts.name: LinkedEmbed
posts.tagline: LinkedIn Widgets for Websites
posts.description: LinkedEmbed is a no-code LinkedIn widget builder that lets you embed LinkedIn feeds, posts, profiles, recommendations, company job listings, projects, and certifications on any website. Create beautiful, customizable LinkedIn widgets for WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, and more. Showcase professional social proof, display LinkedIn content, and track widget views, clicks, and engagement. All from one simple dashboard. No coding required.

posts.name: OXYGEN
posts.tagline: Superintelligence for GTM
posts.description: OXYGEN will acquire your next customer. Oxygents find and enrich leads, run personalised LinkedIn and email sequences that convert and take care of the boring and manual CRM updates. To make sure your product is seen by millions it helps with content on LinkedIn and X. It builds a GTM brain so that you can remove yourself from the loop.

posts.name: TONAUT
posts.tagline: Synth, drums, sequencer and 8-track tape for iPhone and iPad
posts.description: Tonaut is a synth, drum machine, sequencer and eight-track tape for iPhone and iPad, made to be played rather than programmed. 9 synth engines, over 500 sounds, 41 drum kits, a chord pad, 16 effects and an eight-lane sequencer. On iPhone, five housings with key LEDs. $19.99 - one-time purchase for iPhone and iPad. No subscription, no account. AUv3 is coming in 2.0, free.

posts.name: Benchpress
posts.tagline: Every OCR model is #1 somewhere. Test them on your own pages
posts.description: Every OCR model is topping some benchmarks. But can they lift your documents? 💪 Drop in one page, and every major OCR and document AI reads it. See who got it right, where each one slipped, and who was fastest and cheapest.

posts.name: Your Stressy
posts.tagline: One number for your energy, on iPhone and Apple Watch
posts.description: Stressy turns your Apple Watch data into one number, your reserve (0–100%). Sleep fills it, stress drains it. Readiness, a bedtime coach and widgets for iPhone and Watch. Calculated on device, nothing leaves it. $4.99 once, never a subscription.

posts.name: Screenodon
posts.tagline: Nail Your App Store Screenshots
posts.description: Your screenshots do the selling on your App Store page: most people decide in a few seconds, before they read a word. Screenodon helps you make every screen count, and turn page views into installs. Drop in raw screenshots and the AI drafts a conversion-focused set. You art-direct it, localize it into 39 languages, and publish straight to App Store Connect or Google Play. New: all four iPhone Duo sizes. Try the editor without an account.

posts.name: Reels Flow
posts.tagline: Turn ideas and images into AI-powered videos
posts.description: ReelsFlow helps creators, marketers, and businesses turn text prompts and images into AI-generated videos and visuals for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and more. Explore multiple AI models to bring creative ideas to life.

posts.name: Stirred Art
posts.tagline: Strava for bars, Vivino for cocktails
posts.description: Stirred Art scans your photos, detects bars and drinks, builds your flavour profile based on eleven flavours like bitter, smoky and umami, and then personalises bar menus. Everything works offline, so you can get a ranked menu even in the most speakeasy basement out there. It also shows what you can make at home, remembers what each friend drinks (and what they can't), and turns your photos into a map of the bars and drinks you loved.

posts.name: Tabula
posts.tagline: A free native Mac database client with optional offline AI
posts.description: Contribute to tungnguyenvan/tabula development by creating an account on GitHub.

posts.name: InfiForm
posts.tagline: The conversational form builder without response penalties
posts.description: InfiForm is an AI-powered conversational form builder engineered for modern teams. Create high-converting surveys, quizzes, and lead magnets in seconds with natural language prompts, 20+ question archetypes, partial response capture, and zero response penalties.

posts.name: 2G
posts.tagline: neural synthesis, but it’s 2002
posts.description: 2G is a sampler that looks and sounds like an early-2000s handheld devices. We imagined what Neural Synthesis would have been like back then. Describe a sound and 2G makes it. Then edit it and play it from your computer keyboard, or load your own audio instead. 2G is free for Windows and macOS, as a plugin or a standalone app, and starts you with 20 credits for generating sounds. Studio ($10/month, 7-day trial) gives you 200 credits a month.

posts.name: WorkofMe
posts.tagline: Personal brand page, link in bio, and portfolio
posts.description: WorkofMe is a free personal brand page for who you are and what you do. People use the same page as a link in bio and a portfolio at workofme.com/you.

posts.name: FileRanger
posts.tagline: Tabs, two panes and an address bar you can type into
posts.description: A native macOS file manager with tabs, two panes, an address bar you can type into and real cut and paste. Familiar if you come from Windows Explorer. Right-click actions for Git, JSON and images, plus your own. Free 14-day trial, then $9.99 once.

posts.name: Stripeflow Analytics Basic Edition
posts.tagline: StripeFlow offers clearer revenue insights for your business
posts.description: StripeFlow is a complete payment backend starter kit for SaaS products. Instead of spending months figuring out subscriptions, billing, customer portals, invoices, and Stripe edge cases, this gives companies a working payment system they can plug into their app immediately. It’s basically the boring but critical SaaS plumbing that every startup needs — already built.

posts.name: SuperNotch
posts.tagline: 24 everyday tools, right in your Mac notch
posts.description: SuperNotch brings 24 tools to your Mac notch: Smart Search, screen recording, screenshots, clipboard history and more. A native macOS app with a floating layout for notchless displays. Try it free for 3 days, then pay once.

posts.name: Deco My Tree 2026: Christmas Messages
posts.tagline: A Christmas tree your friends decorate with messages
posts.description: Make a Christmas tree, share one link, and friends hang gifts with notes on it. No app or sign-up for them. The notes stay sealed until Christmas Day. Birthday and Valentine's trees too. Free, in 19 languages.

posts.name: Dot Link
posts.tagline: Your ChatGPT Dot on Even G2 smart glasses
posts.description: Not another assistant. On its own, your ChatGPT Dot only knows your conversations. Dot Link adds what it can't reach, like your location and your Mac's notifications when you turn them on, and brings it all to Even G2 smart glasses. Same Dot, same memory. Just say "Hey Dot", no tapping needed. Read replies in the HUD or hear them, and let Dot speak up first. Your own Mac is the relay, so your location and notifications never pass through a server of mine.

posts.name: Dhumketu
posts.tagline: AI-Powered Infinite Learning Platform
posts.description: Learn anything with AI. Explore infinite topic trees, courses, research papers, and books — all powered by artificial intelligence.

posts.name: Notchman: Summarize & Listen
posts.tagline: Text to Speech & AI Summary
posts.description: Too long to read? Hear it instead. Notchman turns long messages, emails, articles, research papers and AI answers into a short spoken TL;DR that keeps every key point, name, date and number. Or have every word read aloud in a natural voice.

posts.name: Qovia
posts.tagline: Chinese social media data for your AI agents, in one API
posts.description: Qovia gives developers and AI agents one API key for public data from Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Bilibili, Weibo, Kuaishou, Zhihu, Taobao/JD reviews, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and X. 100+ endpoints return posts, comments, creator profiles, hot lists and search results in one JSON shape. Plug it into Claude, Cursor or VS Code as a remote MCP server. You only pay for calls that return data, and new accounts get 50 trial calls.

posts.name: Trial & Ticker
posts.tagline: Biotech Catalyst Intelligence
posts.description: Explains how a clinical trial result readout would potentially affect the stock price for all ongoing clinical trials.

posts.name: Pool Calculator
posts.tagline: Free pool volume and water chemistry calculators
posts.description: Free online calculators for pool owners and maintenance professionals to estimate pool volume and common chemical adjustments. Calculate pool shock, liquid chlorine, stabilizer (CYA), salt, pH, and total alkalinity needs.

posts.name: Toronto Citizen
posts.tagline: Toronto community building, Events and transit
posts.description: Get together with ID-verified adults and see what's on in Toronto.

posts.name: Don't Perish
posts.tagline: A wilderness survival game for solo and local co-op
posts.description: Don’t Perish is a wilderness survival game you can play now. Gather resources, craft tools, find food, and keep a campfire burning through the night. Play solo as Edgar or team up with a friend in local split-screen co-op as Mabel. The Kickstarter supports more game artwork, a new website, and marketing, with a larger map and more features planned.

posts.name: IntelliLinks
posts.tagline: Link Intelligence Platform
posts.description: Turn every link into a measurable marketing channel. Create, brand, track, retarget, and optimize your links with IntelliLinks.

posts.name: Dumb Simple Budget
posts.tagline: No accounting degree required.
posts.description: Most budget apps bury you in charts, forecasts and sub-sub-categories. It can be overwhelming! Dumb Simple Budget does one thing: give every dollar a job. Link your bank (via Plaid) and transactions import automatically. Plan each month, drag transactions onto budget lines, and see exactly what's left to spend.

posts.name: Shapoku
posts.tagline: A relaxed block puzzle for iPhone
posts.description: A relaxed block puzzle for iPhone and iPad. Place shapes, clear rows, columns and 3×3 regions, and make room for your next move. Free, offline, and ad-free.

posts.name: Deyn Studio
posts.tagline: AI Video editor & media assisstent
posts.description: Stop renting your media tools. Deyn Studio is a local video editor and media assistant that clips, captions, reframes, converts, and compresses on your own machine. Press Option + D over any app, say what you want, and keep working. Shrink for social media, cut filler words, find the best moments, reframe to vertical, and automate it across hundreds of files. Your video never leaves your device. Bring your own AI key: $5 can last months, not $20 every month.

posts.name: Spino
posts.tagline: Back pain, again? Sit up, or your screen dims! For Macs.
posts.description: Spino dims your screen when you slouch and clears it when you sit up. Posture app for the macOS menu bar, free for 4 hours a day. Nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Agent Replay
posts.tagline: Turn your coding agent sessions into videos
posts.description: Your agent did something worth sharing. Say "make a replay of this session" and get a video that looks like the real terminal. Works with Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode. Cut captioned highlights or add a replay GIF to your PR. Free and open source.

posts.name: Muse Otter
posts.tagline: The AI journal that only asks once a week
posts.description: Most journaling apps want you every day, and most people quit by Thursday. Muse Otter asks once a week. Capture thoughts in seconds during the week, by voice, text or photo. Then take 7 minutes for a guided weekly review. Lumi, your otter companion, turns it into a recap card with themes, patterns and one honest line, and learns what matters to you over time. Private by design. On iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.

posts.name: Shipper
posts.tagline: Create, localize & publish App Store screenshots
posts.description: Spend less time preparing your App Store listing. Design screenshots, adapt easily in different Apple specifications, localize faster your screenshots and metadata, and upload to App Store Connect. Native for Mac. With iPhone Duo, new Search and Header assets are supported.

posts.name: Taboo AI: Explain it. Learn it.
posts.tagline: Learn English by making AI guess your words
posts.description: Describe a word without saying the obvious ones. AI guesses, then a coach shows how to make your clue clearer. Save words, practice them, take the daily challenge, or race friends. Free to play, with one coach review a day on a free account.

posts.name: CineUp AI
posts.tagline: 4K Spatial Cinema Remastering Suite & 2D to 3D VR
posts.description: CineUp AI is an offline AI video remastering suite for Windows. Restore vintage film textures, upscale to 4K cascade, master in 10-bit HDR, and convert 2D videos to Spatial 3D/VR.

posts.name: PaperReady: Offline PDF Tools
posts.tagline: Merge, split and compress PDFs on your phone, fully offline
posts.description: PaperReady gets a document ready to submit in one workspace. Combine PDFs and photos, reorder, rotate or remove pages, extract or split ranges, and turn photos into A4 pages. Compress images to a balanced, smaller or exact target size, then check the real file size and page count against the upload limit before you send. Everything runs offline on your phone; originals are never changed. All tools are free, supported by banner ads.

posts.name: Backgap
posts.tagline: Find out who doesn't follow you back on Threads
posts.description: Chrome extension that shows who doesn't follow you back on Threads and unfollows them in bulk. Scan your whole following list, shield the accounts you want to keep, and unfollow the rest at a pace you set — without ever entering your Threads password.

posts.name: Free Halloween Retro Generator
posts.tagline: Turn your weirdest Halloween ideas into a team retro board
posts.description: A free Halloween retro generator that turns your weirdest ideas into fully illustrated, ready-to-run retrospective boards. Pick a mini-game, choose a team check-in, describe a ridiculous scenario, and watch Spreo build the whole thing in seconds. Under the hood, it's powered by Spreo's MCP server, which lets AI agents create and edit real collaborative whiteboards. This is our slightly unhinged Halloween demonstration of what's possible. Free to use, no sign up required. What would you type?

posts.name: Drint
posts.tagline: Packaging design software: dielines, 3D mockups, print files
posts.description: Drint is packaging design software in the browser. Pick a structure or a FEFCO / ECMA code, type the size, and design straight on a real dieline while the 3D mockup folds as you draw. Export print-ready CMYK PDF/X-4 with cut and crease lines, plus finishing files for foil, spot UV and embossing. About a thousand ready mockups for boxes, bags, cartons, cans and labels, in 14+ languages. Free to start.

posts.name: FroggyAds
posts.tagline: Self-Serve DSP & Global Ad Network Platform
posts.description: FroggyAds is a self-serve demand-side platform and ad network. Advertisers, media buyers, affiliate marketers and agencies can manage push, native, display, pop, video and interstitial campaigns from one dashboard. Features include audience targeting, bid and budget controls, SmartCPC optimization, Adscore-supported traffic screening, source-level reporting and whitelists or blacklists. Advertising uses a prepaid balance, with a $50 minimum deposit. Actual costs depend on auction conditions.

posts.name: Top 1% Learning OS
posts.tagline: Think like the top 1%: Consulting VC IB we got you covered
posts.description: A free learning site for people with a high need for cognition. 12 tracks, from Venture Capital and Investment Banking to Consulting, Strategy and AI: 283 curated reads, 229 module kits, 8 practice cases. Email-code sign-in; progress syncs across devices.

posts.name: NextPress CMS is in Alpha
posts.tagline: All of WordPress in JavaScript, now available for testing.
posts.description: WordPress powers a huge share of the web, but it still runs on a stack many teams do not want to maintain: PHP. This results in vulnerable and slower websites. NextPress keeps what works (pages, posts, media, blocks, SEO, a WordPress-compatible REST API) and rebuilds it on a modern JavaScript stack: Node.js, a React admin, and fast server-rendered pages. Get a clean codebase your team can actually extend in TypeScript.

posts.name: UGC Creator Search
posts.tagline: Describe the creator you need, get a live shortlist
posts.description: Type a brief in plain English, such as fitness UGC creators in the UK with 5k to 25k followers and a portfolio link, and get a preview of matching Instagram and TikTok creators from a live index of 24,000+. Full profiles, verified emails and exports live inside UGC Agent. Free preview, no signup to search.

posts.name: PM Questions by Company by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: PM interview questions for Google, Meta, OpenAI and 257 more
posts.description: Company-specific PM interview prep for 260 companies: 948 Google questions, 757 Meta, 274 Amazon, 105 Anthropic, 98 OpenAI and more. Each company hub shows the questions by type, the company's open PM roles, and a one-click mock interview built from a real job description there. Free.

posts.name: Tune Looper
posts.tagline: Loop and slow down YouTube phrases for music practice
posts.description: Practice the exact phrase that needs work. Find a song on YouTube, mark the section, loop it, and slow playback down for focused repetition. Save and edit sections for later sessions, share them with someone you are teaching, and browse curated or community song lists. Tune Looper is built for musicians, transcription and learning tricky passages without constant scrubbing. Works in the browser, with a free plan and optional paid upgrades. Also available on Android.

posts.name: Tabie
posts.tagline: Browser made easy!
posts.description: I Built Tabie because I never close tabs. I was on my 47th tab then i realize no browser comes with a Tab manager! and here Tabie born : Tabie.web.app. I am also building worlds fastest browser! Stay Tuned! - Install on any chrome Browser. - Find any tab in 3 keystrokes. - Clean the rest in one click. Free, zero data collected. https://Tabie.web.app

posts.name: Still Studio
posts.tagline: Free image size reducer
posts.description: Free online image resizer, compressor, and converter. Resize JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP images privately in your browser — no uploads, no account required.

posts.name: Setup Kit by Unreasonably Fast
posts.tagline: The Mac setup kit to work unreasonably fast
posts.description: An opinionated Mac setup kit: one cloud, a folder structure you can copy, file names that sort themselves, and shortcuts that stick. 27 chapters plus an AI folder wizard with ZIP export. Install it in a weekend. First 50 pay €39.

posts.name: 吐槽墙
posts.tagline: Anonymous venting wall
posts.description: I built an anonymous venting wall: no signup, no usernames, 10 languages. People post what they can't say at work or on social media, and it stays semi-anonymous. Stack: Flask + PostgreSQL + nginx on a single $6/mo VPS (2 vCPU / 894MB RAM), Docker Compose. It's survived one self-inflicted OOM outage (built a Docker image on the 894MB box - lesson learned). Happy to answer anything about the build (analytics bugs, OOM, multi-language SEO) or the cold-start problem.

posts.name: Fewr
posts.tagline: Save up to 53% less Claude Code and Codex usage
posts.description: Fewr makes Claude Code and Codex hand the legwork to cheaper models while your model keeps the hard calls. Up to 53% less usage on the same model, measured as real cost, not tokens. Runs locally through native hooks. Free and open source.

posts.name: Browser AI History
posts.tagline: Your AI chat history, all in one place.
posts.description: Save ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Manus chats in one local archive. A companion Skill lets Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor search that history and reuse it as context. Agent access requires the optional local bridge.

posts.name: Pipeline Simple
posts.tagline: Make more money with GEO(Generative Engine Optimization)
posts.description: We get your brand cited and recommended in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot, and fix what they get wrong. Our GEO agent catches outdated pricing, wrong features, and bad positioning, traces each claim to its source, then corrects your site, listings, and profiles, pitches publishers, and publishes quotable, answer-first facts with structured data. It also samples prompts repeatedly, benchmarks competitors, audits crawler access, builds reviews, and tracks AI-sourced leads.

posts.name: Recall
posts.tagline: Search your whole Mac by what's in things, on-device
posts.description: Find files, screenshots and clipboard history by meaning, from one hotkey. Everything runs on your Mac and nothing is uploaded. No account. Every install gets a 14-day Pro trial, no signup or card. Apple Silicon, macOS 14+.

posts.name: Mentio
posts.tagline: Record now. Save the good part.
posts.description: Ever wish you’d hit record a few seconds earlier? Start Mentio before a conversation, lecture, or practice session, then save the last few seconds or minutes when you hear something worth keeping. Trim audio and video, add notes and tags, and transcribe speech on your iPhone. Keep the parts you want without sorting through a long recording.

posts.name: Wageso
posts.tagline: Cashflow, debts and investments without bank connections
posts.description: Wageso now brings asset and investment tracking, debts, spending budgets and savings goals alongside monthly cashflow. Set up recurring income and payments to see what's left this month, without connecting a bank account. Start without signing up. No ads, encrypted sync, and iPhone and Android support. Core tracking is free; asset and investment tracking, spending budgets and savings goals are available with Pro.

posts.name: MokuMoku.town
posts.tagline: A cozy pixel-art space to work, study, and watch together
posts.description: Work and study alongside others in a cozy browser-based pixel town. Now with mobile support, friends, direct room links, YouTube playlist queues, personal saved lists, and watch history. Share a room and some music, without turning on your camera or mic.

posts.name: Wanderfox AI
posts.tagline: The AI trip planner that only plans real places
posts.description: Describe a trip in one sentence and get a day-by-day itinerary of real places, mapped and timed. Plan with friends: propose changes, vote and split costs. Compare destinations, or start from a creator's ready-made itinerary. Free to start.

posts.name: CodeZen
posts.tagline: AI assistant that builds your product and bills via WhatsApp
posts.description: Describe your app in plain language, even on WhatsApp. CodeZen's AI agents plan, build and deploy it, then keep shipping changes toward the KPI you set. Living code: you own it, no lock-in, EU servers. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: Mimic
posts.tagline: Accent coach for American and British English
posts.description: Mimic is an accent coach for people who already speak English and want to sound American or British. It plays a short line, you say it back, and a second later it tells you which sound gave you away and how to fix it. Ten minutes a day.

posts.name: PowCircle
posts.tagline: The Operating System for Powerlifting Coaches
posts.description: PowCircle brings powerlifting coaching into one platform. Coaches can build training programs, plan seasons, manage athletes, and monitor progress, wellness, and meet preparation. Athletes log their workouts, RPE, and training videos through the iOS and Android app.

posts.name: NavyGoal
posts.tagline: NavyGoal: Navigate Your Goals. Earn Your Rank.
posts.description: Track your progress with beautiful charts and insights to stay motivated on your journey.

posts.name: JIMMY
posts.tagline: JIMMY is an AI agent that runs on your PC
posts.description: JIMMY runs on your Windows PC and listens to your WhatsApp self-chat. Text "send the resume in Downloads to Rahul" or "screenshot" and it does the task, asks before sending anything, and replies. Scheduled tasks, custom commands, /stop and an undo log included.

posts.name: Your DNA is your software talk to it
posts.tagline: We give your DNA profile for your personlized Drug
posts.description: Discover personalized health insights from your DNA with our secure and scientifically backed analysis.

posts.name: Lock&Learn Trivia
posts.tagline: Trivia questions on your iPhone Lock Screen and widgets
posts.description: Turn your iPhone Lock Screen into a tiny trivia game. A question waits on your widget. Take a guess, tap, and get the answer with the fact behind it. 12 topics and 1,000+ questions, from space to food, plus a full-screen feed and a Quiz with streaks. Every topic has a free preview and a new free question each day, no account needed. Plus opens them all.

posts.name: parte.
posts.tagline: AI family assistant with a shared family calendar
posts.description: Forward a school email, snap a letter or send a WhatsApp, and parte. puts every date on your shared family calendar. Colour-coded per person, works across homes, and turns an old iPad into a wall display. Free, with 5 AI intakes a month.

posts.name: Loudship
posts.tagline: Find the threads asking for what you built. Reply as you.
posts.description: Every morning, Loudship emails you the Reddit, Hacker News and Bluesky threads where someone is asking for what you built, each with a draft reply written only from facts you approved. It never posts: you edit it and reply from your own account.

posts.name: FactifAI
posts.tagline: Fact-check claims with AI and inspect the sources
posts.description: FactifAI turns statements from speeches, debates, and headlines into evidence-backed fact checks. It searches the web, compares sources, highlights uncertainty, and links to the evidence. Start free with a Basic report or go deeper with a Full report and PDF.

posts.name: Mainfront
posts.tagline: One Inventory, Published Everywhere.
posts.description: Digital distribution and discovery infrastructure for growing businesses: manage one master inventory, and Mainfront distributes it everywhere you sell.

posts.name: lum9a
posts.tagline: The cutest to-do list. Free forever
posts.description: Do the task. Watch your world grow. Free forever.

posts.name: Buoy
posts.tagline: A desktop home for tmux, files, and remote localhost
posts.description: Buoy is a free, open-source desktop tmux client for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Reconnect to running sessions, preview files and self-contained HTML in place, recognize localhost links, open remote services through automatic SSH tunnels, and drag files or folders into the terminal to upload them to its current directory.

posts.name: Waver AI
posts.tagline: Voice-first notes with an AI that remembers
posts.description: Waver AI is a voice-first notes app that does far more than take notes. Record, dictate, scan handwriting, talk to an AI that remembers what you said, and turn ideas into images, video and music in one place. Made by Aerosoul Technologies, a new company in Chennai building apps for everyday life.

posts.name: Vigilo
posts.tagline: Auto-refresh + keyword alert for Chrome
posts.description: Reload any tab on a timer and get a desktop alert when a keyword appears (STOCK, available…) or the page changes. Works on logged-in pages, per-site permission, nothing leaves your browser. Free; Pro $4.99 once — no subscription.

posts.name: Gita Connects
posts.tagline: See how the Bhagavad Gita’s verses speak to each other
posts.description: A free canvas for studying the Bhagavad Gita as connected verses. All 701 verses, with 1,057 curated links across 10 colour-coded types, each with a strength rating and a one-line reason. Add your own links and notes. No account, no cookies.

posts.name: NaakaAlert
posts.tagline: Live naaka alerts from fellow commuters, with safe energy
posts.description: NaakaAlert is a free, real-time map where commuters pin traffic checkpoints (naakas). Get alerted within 500 m, confirm or clear pins, and old pins expire on their own. Speaks English, Hinglish & Hyderabadi, with a pre-ride Vibe Check to ride legal.

posts.name: Nu
posts.tagline: The personal agent that runs on your rules
posts.description: Nu is a self-hosted personal agent you can talk to from the terminal or any chat app. Every tool call is checked against your policy, and anything you haven't allowed waits for your approval. Every step is recorded, so a crash or restart resumes where it stopped without repeating work. Shell commands run in a sandbox that holds none of your secrets, and packages can add to or change almost anything Nu does. MIT licensed.

posts.name: Rescanzo
posts.tagline: Find the moment you need in your footage in seconds
posts.description: Hey Product Hunt 👋 Rescanzo lets you search hours of raw footage the way you’d brief an assistant. Type “sunset over the city” or “where they talk about the plan for the day” and it finds the matching moments, ranks them and marks them on the timeline. Send them to Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, VEGAS or CapCut in one action. Low and Mid modes run fully on your computer. Pro adds a cloud double-check and speech search. The application supports Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Stashly
posts.tagline: Stashly — All your content, one link.
posts.description: Stashly is a tool for content creators. Stop maintaining 40-link descriptions. Stashly keeps all your products, codes and projects in one place, always up to date. Customers are able to see only relevant links, code and stuff.

posts.name: ByteMuni
posts.tagline: Tech wisdom, byte by byte
posts.description: Tutorials, interview preparation and practical guides on programming (JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js), AI, DevOps, databases and cyber security.

posts.name: Ohole
posts.tagline: Connect, date, share and discover in one app
posts.description: Ohole is a Namibian-developed app for sharing moments, meeting people and discovering creators. Post photos and videos, chat directly, explore creator music and browse local marketplace listings. Optional dating and compatibility matching help adults find new connections. Built by On-delo for communities across Africa and beyond.

posts.name: TripoWay
posts.tagline: Turn old boarding passes into visa-ready travel logs
posts.description: TripoWay turns old boarding passes, booking emails, and passport stamps into embassy-ready travel logs. Snap a photo or upload a pass—our AI extracts flight dates, ports, and duration of stay. Generate clean travel history PDFs for Schengen, US, and UK visa applications, or track European stays with the 90/180 Schengen calculator. No more guessing past entry and exit dates.

posts.name: Zipprr
posts.tagline: Launch a Grab-style all-in-one mobility app
posts.description: Launch your own Grab-style super app with Zipprr’s Grab Clone Script. Bring ride-hailing, food delivery, parcel delivery, and more under one brand with a customizable, white-label solution. Get the source code, customize it for your business needs, and launch with a one-time payment of $490 — no monthly subscription fees.

posts.name: SideNote  - Notes, Tasks & Scratchpad
posts.tagline: Domain-aware sidebar notes & Keep-style dashboard for Chrome
posts.description: Clean notes and voice memos right in your Chrome side panel. 100% private and local-first.

posts.name: Gibberifier
posts.tagline: LLM & Web Scraping Blocker
posts.description: Gibberifier - Block AIs and web scrapers from reading your text with invisible Unicode characters while preserving meaning for humans.

posts.name: Abra Kadabra AI Dance Generator
posts.tagline: Turn One Photo into a Twin Dance with Original Music
posts.description: Create an 11-second twin dance from one photo. One version keeps your outfit; the other wears a floral wrap dress and dances barefoot. The living-room scene, routine and original soundtrack are included. Choose Basic or Pro, review the credit quote, then download a 3:4 MP4. Paid credits required. Likeness, clothing details and synchronization may vary.

posts.name: Knock
posts.tagline: Create shortcuts by hitting you mac
posts.description: Knock is a shortcut app that lets you control your Mac by simply knocking on it. Tap the sides of your laptop and it runs any shortcut you want — screenshot, open apps, mute sound, and more. It uses your Mac's built-in accelerometer to actually feel the vibration of your knock and react in real time, no extra hardware needed - just knock and go.

posts.name: Wingmates
posts.tagline: The community for pilots, from dream to flight deck.
posts.description: Wingmates brings the pilot journey into one place: verified aviation guides, DGCA mock tests, flying-school data, 10-year flying-weather analysis, pilot answers, stories and real airline selection debriefs.
